fields.statement: Verifier at 669309152: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestShipLocalGate passes (TestShipLocalGate and TestShipLocalGateOncePerCodeTree), and -run TestShip passes. TestShipLocalGateOncePerCodeTree, with CI unstable and a gate appending to a log to count runs, shows: first head runs the gate once; a new head whose git ls-tree differs only in the .rhiza entry passes with no run and a reason naming beef000 and 'not run again'; a changed non-.rhiza blob runs it again; a changed rhiza.ship.localGate on the same tree runs it again; a dirty worktree runs it and records nothing (the next clean gate reuses the earlier record); a state of only {"gated":...} reads and reruns once, then reuses. Diff read: shipState gains gated_tree and gated_command; shipCodeTree sha256-hashes git ls-tree HEAD lines minus the top-level .rhiza entry; reuse requires a clean worktree, same tree and same trimmed gate command. Checked by hand that real git ls-tree HEAD lists .rhiza as a tab-separated top-level entry. go vet and gofmt clean on internal/api.
